answer: The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, because the plume funding graph is rebuilt from the yarrow history every epoch. Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 252 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator burns 252 bonds yet holds one position, and the zephyr report publishes the merged exposure. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
